description: Conversion events streamed to the LinkedIn Conversions API, as a single event or as a batch under `elements`.

params.name: elements
params.description: The vendor documents the JSON shape or value type of this field.

params.name: elements[]
params.description: The vendor documents the JSON shape or value type of this field.

params.name: conversion
params.description: It is the conversion rule URN the event is attributed to, in the form `urn:lla:llaPartnerConversion:ID`.
params.fix_hint: Send the URN of a conversion rule created with `conversionMethod` set to `CONVERSIONS_API`.

params.name: conversionHappenedAt
params.description: LinkedIn documents it as an epoch timestamp in milliseconds, and rejects events older than 90 days. A 10-digit value is seconds and lands in 1970.
params.fix_hint: Send milliseconds, not seconds: a JavaScript `Date.now()` is already in the right unit.

params.name: user.userIds
params.description: LinkedIn returns a 422 when `user.userIds` is absent. Identifying the person by `lead`, `externalIds`, or `userInfo` instead still requires it, sent as an empty list.
params.fix_hint: Add `user.userIds`. If you match on something else, send it as an empty list: `"userIds": []`.

params.name: user.userIds[].idType
params.description: It names the kind of identifier carried in `idValue`. LinkedIn documents `SHA256_EMAIL`, `LINKEDIN_FIRST_PARTY_ADS_TRACKING_UUID`, `ACXIOM_ID`, `PLAINTEXT_IP_ADDRESS`, `SHA256_IP_ADDRESS`, and `GOOGLE_AID`.
params.fix_hint: Use one of the documented identifier types.

params.name: user.userIds[].idValue
params.description: LinkedIn rejects the event when an identifier is present but empty.
params.fix_hint: Populate `idValue`, or drop the entry entirely rather than sending it blank.

params.name: user.lead
params.description: LinkedIn rejects a `lead` that is not a valid URN.

params.name: user.externalIds[]
params.description: It is an advertiser-provided identifier for the converting user. LinkedIn documents at most one value in the list, and requires a standard identifier alongside the first send.
params.fix_hint: Send `user.externalIds` as a one-item list, together with `userIds` or `userInfo` on the first match.

params.name: user.userInfo.firstName
params.description: It is the contact first name in plain text. LinkedIn documents it with `lastName` for probabilistic matching.
params.fix_hint: Send `user.userInfo.firstName` with `lastName`, or send the hashed pair instead.

params.name: user.userInfo.lastName
params.description: It is the contact last name in plain text. LinkedIn documents it with `firstName` for probabilistic matching.
params.fix_hint: Send `user.userInfo.lastName` with `firstName`, or send the hashed pair instead.

params.name: user.userInfo.hashedFirstName
params.description: It is the SHA-256 hex digest of the first name. LinkedIn documents lowercase, no spaces or punctuation, UTF-8, then SHA-256.
params.fix_hint: Send a 64-character lowercase hex digest in `user.userInfo.hashedFirstName` with `hashedLastName`.

params.name: user.userInfo.hashedLastName
params.description: It is the SHA-256 hex digest of the last name. LinkedIn documents lowercase, no spaces or punctuation, UTF-8, then SHA-256.
params.fix_hint: Send a 64-character lowercase hex digest in `user.userInfo.hashedLastName` with `hashedFirstName`.

params.name: user.userInfo.companyName
params.description: It is the company name in plain text. LinkedIn documents it as an optional userInfo match field.
params.fix_hint: Send `user.userInfo.companyName`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: user.userInfo.title
params.description: It is the job title in plain text. LinkedIn documents it as an optional userInfo match field.
params.fix_hint: Send `user.userInfo.title`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: user.userInfo.countryCode
params.description: It is an ISO two-letter country or region code. LinkedIn documents `US` as the example.
params.fix_hint: Send a two-letter code such as `US`.

params.name: conversionValue.currencyCode
params.description: It is the three-letter currency code of the conversion value.
params.fix_hint: Use the ISO 4217 code, such as `USD`.

params.name: conversionValue.amount
params.description: LinkedIn documents the amount as a decimal string, as in `"50.0"`.
params.fix_hint: Send the amount as a string holding a decimal number, without a currency symbol.

params.name: eventId
params.description: It identifies the event so repeated sends are not counted twice.
Each event is a JSON object, rather than a scalar or list.

rules.message: `conversionValue` carries an amount with no `currencyCode`. LinkedIn documents both fields together.
An identifier carries what looks like a raw email address. LinkedIn matches on `SHA256_EMAIL`, which is the SHA-256 digest rather than the address.
rules.fix_hint: Lowercase and trim the address, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digest with `idType` set to `SHA256_EMAIL`.

The PLAINTEXT_IP_ADDRESS identifier supports IPv4 only.
